name: Secrets Guard
description: Keep secrets out of code, git history, logs, and client bundles: detect hardcoded API keys, credentials, tokens, and connection strings; move them to the environment or a secret manager; catch client-exposed prefixes; set up gitignore and pre-commit scanning; run the rotate-first response when a secret has leaked. Use for any credential, .env, or "where do I put my key?" question.
verification_requirements: secret absent from the built client bundle and from git history, shown
pre-commit or CI secret scanner blocks a test secret
rotated credential confirmed revoked at the provider
